items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: I'll never forget what John Casimir had in his band.

ctx.x: He'd have his little grandson, a great-grandson or something. Yeah, little grandson, yeah. His grandson, I remember that.

You know that boy got killed. No, I didn't know that. Yeah, he was a drummer, you know. And some woman shot him in Texas. About two years ago. He was a nice drummer. The little lady killed me. Yeah, George, sure. George was something one time. He was a kickster. But he was a good drummer, though. A good drummer and a good bass drum player, too. I'll never forget what John Casimir had in his band. Knox was out the union, and Knox couldn't play with nothing. So George said, I'm tired of playing this bass drum. I'm…
Well this was after Steve died, because you wouldn't remember this.
